name: A4F
short: Unified AI proxy and gateway providing access to hundreds of LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible API key with a free tier.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key upon sign-up (no credit card required). Grants access to explore and query a broad catalog of open and hosted models locally via api.a4f.co/v1.

plans.name: Pro / Credit Pack
plans.notes: Higher request concurrency, priority routing, failovers, and expanded access to premium frontier model pipelines.
